title: AniMathIO community plugin registry
description: Hand-edited list of community plugins (submitted by pull request). Nothing here changes per plugin version: versions, download URLs and checksums are resolved from GitHub releases into community-index.json.

delisted.description: Plugins removed from the registry. Their ids stay reserved and the editor tells users who installed them.

id.description: Reverse-domain plugin id: lowercase, at least three dot-separated labels, never org.animathio.* (reserved for first-party plugins).

repo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) whose releases carry the .amplugin files.

repo_id.description: Numeric GitHub id of repo (`gh api repos/<owner>/<name> --jq .id`). Required outside AniMathIO/plugins: new releases are indexed automatically, so the index builder refuses a different repository at the configured name until a maintainer re-reviews it. Renames and transfers preserve this id; ownership changes are not detected.

path.description: Subdirectory of repo that holds the plugin (plugin.toml, build.sh). Present for monorepos, including every plugin hosted in AniMathIO/plugins (community/<name>); when present, release tags must be <id>@<version>.

license.description: SPDX license expression, e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0 OR MIT, or MIT AND OFL-1.1 when a bundled font is OFL. Every identifier must be OSI-approved or an SIL OFL variant (schemas/osi-approved-licenses.txt).

min_abi.description: Plugin ABI (plugin.toml api_version) of the latest release: the minimum host ABI the plugin needs.
